evals.name: lightweight-chinese-hello
evals.prompt: 只测试任务分发功能。请把 hello 发到 smarthub、smarthub-web 和 smart-go-web，收到后让每个任务只回复 hello。不要修改文件，也不要跟踪结果。
evals.expected_output: 直接执行轻量中文批量分发，不增加确认；父任务只报告目标和投递结果，每个子任务收到一条简短可读消息。
assertions: Uses lightweight direct-message delivery rather than a formal package.
Human-facing titles and instructions are Chinese.
Each child prompt starts with a readable Markdown title using the format 主任务名称 - 子任务名称.
The hello case uses a title equivalent to 任务分发测试 - 回复你好.
Each complete task message explains the goal, exact action, boundaries, and completion response.
Each task message is under 30 lines.
No Markdown package files, manifest, checksums, chunks, or TASK_PACKAGE markers are generated.
No repository action or result tracking is requested.
No additional confirmation is requested after the explicit send command.
The parent does not display routes, project IDs, branches, or protocol details.

evals.name: three-project-dispatch-preview
evals.prompt: Dry-run only. A confirmed distributed-log design assigns Web UI to smarthub-web, BFF endpoints to smarthub-admin, and SDK plus log-service to drone-cloud-api. Base Graph and Codex Projects match all three roots exactly. Preview how you would distribute the work. The user has not requested tracking or receipts. Do not create tasks or call thread tools.
evals.expected_output: A compact Dispatch-mode preview containing only the objective, three targets with one-line responsibilities, dependency order, and material risks.
assertions: No task or thread is created during the dry-run.
Dispatch is selected by default without forcing an A/B choice.
The preview shows only the objective, targets, one-line responsibilities, dependencies, and material risks.
Full Markdown documents, checksums, project IDs, host IDs, absolute paths, and branches are not displayed.
No worktree, branch switch, push, or cross-project integration test is proposed.

evals.name: proactive-after-stable-design
evals.prompt: We have just finished and confirmed an inventory feature design spanning warehouse-api, warehouse-web, and billing-adapter. The design is stable, but I have not asked to create tasks yet. Respond with the next helpful step only. This is a dry-run; do not create tasks.
evals.expected_output: One short sentence offering to distribute the confirmed design to the three named projects.
assertions: The response proactively offers multi-project distribution.
It does not force an A/B choice or show package, route, or checksum details.
It asks only whether to distribute.
No task or thread is created.

evals.name: development-dependency-chain
evals.prompt: Dry-run a Development-mode split for a confirmed API change with dependency order SDK -> BFF -> Web. Each project exists as a saved Codex Project and its Base Graph path matches. Show packages, scheduling, and completion rules. Do not create tasks.
evals.expected_output: A dependency-aware Development preview that serializes SDK, BFF, and Web and requires project-local tests and local commits.
assertions: Development mode is selected explicitly.
The dependency chain is SDK then BFF then Web.
Every child receives a complete three-document package.
Normal completion requires project-local tests and at least one local commit.
No push or cross-project integration test is required.
No task or thread is created during the dry-run.

evals.name: base-path-fallback
evals.prompt: Dry-run only. Project Graph assigns one child to edge-collector. Base Graph resolves D:\workspace\edge\edge-collector and the directory exists, but Codex list_projects has no saved edge-collector project. The current Codex Project is control-center. Preview the route and full package without creating a task.
evals.expected_output: A BASE_PATH_FALLBACK preview that creates no worktree and makes the Base Graph root the mandatory child workdir.
assertions: The route is BASE_PATH_FALLBACK.
The session project remains control-center.
targetWorkdir is D:\workspace\edge\edge-collector.
The child must verify its Git root and avoid modifying the session project.
No task or thread is created.

evals.name: ambiguous-route-blocks
evals.prompt: Dry-run only. Base Graph resolves D:\workspace\shared\portal, but Codex list_projects returns two saved Projects with normalized paths that both resolve to that same directory. Show what the dispatcher should do. Do not create tasks.
evals.expected_output: A concise BLOCKED result with no task creation until ambiguity is fixed.
assertions: The route is BLOCKED.
The ambiguity is reported as an unresolved issue.
Delivery remains blocked while the route is ambiguous.
No task or thread is created.

evals.name: discussion-only-dispatch
evals.prompt: Dry-run a split discussion across telemetry-api and observability-console. The goal is to compare two interface alternatives and report decisions; nobody asked for code, tests, commits, or result tracking. Both routes are verified. Preview the task packages only.
evals.expected_output: A Dispatch-mode preview whose child task kind stays discussion and contains no implementation demand.
assertions: Dispatch mode is used by default.
Both child task kinds remain discussion.
The packages request analysis and decisions rather than code changes.
No development receipt, commit, or test requirement is imposed.
No task or thread is created.

evals.name: formal-chinese-human-readable-package
evals.prompt: 只做 dry-run。日志下载方案已经确认，涉及 smarthub-web、smarthub 和 drone-cloud-api，包含接口约定、依赖顺序和各项目验收条件。请用中文预览正式分发包，不要创建真实任务。
evals.expected_output: 正式三文档预览，标题和正文为中文，先呈现目标、职责、边界和验收，再在末尾放路由与校验信息。
assertions: Uses the formal three-document package because shared contracts and dependencies exist.
Human-facing headings and prose are Chinese.
The documents do not contain template instructions or exhaustive unrelated task-kind lists.
Unused sections are omitted instead of producing walls of Not applicable.
Route identifiers and checksums appear in compact technical appendices after the human-readable content.
No real task or thread is created during the dry-run.

evals.name: explicit-formal-dispatch-no-extra-confirmation
evals.prompt: 日志下载方案已经确认，目标是 smarthub-web、smarthub 和 drone-cloud-api。现在直接分发，完整 Markdown 放进各自子任务，不需要在父任务预览，也不要再问我是否确认。
evals.expected_output: 完成必要路由解析后直接创建三个任务；父任务只显示简短进度和最终投递结果，完整 Markdown 与技术元数据仅发送给对应子任务。
assertions: The explicit distribute command is treated as authorization.
No additional confirmation or A/B mode question is asked.
The parent does not display full Markdown, checksums, project IDs, host IDs, absolute paths, or branches.
Each child receives the full human-readable Markdown context and its required technical appendix.
Each child initial prompt starts with 主任务名称 - 子任务名称, before any TASK_PACKAGE_BEGIN marker.
TASK_PACKAGE_BEGIN is retained only as an internal marker below the readable title and purpose.
The final parent response reports only targets, delivery status, and blockers if any.
No worktree, branch switch, or push is introduced.

evals.name: formal-child-title-before-package-marker
evals.prompt: 把“视频流联调”正式分发给 smarthub-web，子任务负责前端验证。完整 Markdown 直接发送给子任务，不要让 TASK_PACKAGE_BEGIN 变成任务标题。
evals.expected_output: 子任务首行为“视频流联调 - smarthub-web 前端验证”，一句话目的随后，TASK_PACKAGE_BEGIN 位于其后并仅承担内部协议作用。
assertions: The first line is a Markdown heading in the format 视频流联调 - smarthub-web 前端验证.
A one-sentence human-readable purpose follows the title.
TASK_PACKAGE_BEGIN appears below the title and purpose.
The title and purpose match the packaged objective and owned scope.
No dispatch ID, checksum, UUID, project ID, or protocol marker is used as the task title.
The formal package documents and checksums remain unchanged below the header.

evals.name: tracked-read-only-dispatch
evals.prompt: Dry-run only. Ask smarthub, smarthub-web, smart-go-web, smarthub-zlmediakit, and drone-cloud-api to report their current local branch, HEAD, declared version, and dirty/clean status. I explicitly want the parent to wait for and aggregate every result, but this is read-only work: no development, tests, commits, or pushes. Do not create tasks during this dry-run.
evals.expected_output: Dispatch remains selected with awaitResult=true, every child receives the receipt-first JSON envelope contract, and no Development commit or test requirements are added.
assertions: Dispatch remains the selected mode and awaitResult=true is explicit.
The response does not introduce a third user-facing mode.
The parent plans to use wait_threads and the deterministic task projection.
Every tracked child must put one versioned JSON receipt envelope before optional human details.
No project-local test, commit, push, worktree, or cross-project integration requirement is imposed.
No task or thread is created during the dry-run.
